definitions.gloss: snow viewing; enjoying the snow scenery
definitions.explanation: The aesthetic appreciation of snow-covered landscapes, traditionally enjoyed from indoors while drinking tea or sake. One of the seasonal viewing traditions alongside cherry blossom viewing and moon viewing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{露天風呂|ろてんぶろ}→露天風呂：14611_rotenburo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{雪見|ゆきみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: I enjoyed viewing the snow from the outdoor hot spring bath.

examples.japanese: {雪見|ゆきみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{格別|かくべつ}→格別：00154_kakubetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Drinking warm sake while viewing the snow is a special pleasure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雪見|ゆきみ}{灯籠|どうろう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶって→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧、⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦らしい→らしい：09502_rashii⟧⟦{風情|ふぜい}→風情：09057_fuzei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧になった。
examples.english: The snow-viewing lantern in the garden was covered with snow, creating a scene with winter charm.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧ (snow) and ⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧ (viewing). Part of the Japanese tradition of seasonal nature appreciation alongside ⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧ (cherry blossom viewing) and ⟦{月見|つきみ}→月見：13001_tsukimi⟧ (moon viewing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雪見|ゆきみ}{灯籠|どうろう} (snow-viewing lantern — a type of stone garden lantern)
- {雪見|ゆきみ}{酒|ざけ} (sake enjoyed while viewing snow)
- {雪見|ゆきみ}{風呂|ぶろ} (bath with a view of snow)
- {雪見|ゆきみ}だいふく (Yukimi Daifuku — a popular ice cream brand by Lotte)

The {雪見|ゆきみ}{灯籠|どうろう} is a distinctive type of short stone lantern with wide legs, designed to look beautiful when snow accumulates on top. It is a common element in Japanese gardens.
